title: Crestline Summit Loyalty Program Terms: Award Tickets and Redeposit
content:
These terms govern award tickets issued from a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program membership.

**1. Pricing.** Award tickets are priced one way per passenger from the saver award chart when saver seats are available on every flight, and from the standard award chart otherwise, by the award zone of the itinerary and the award cabin. A round trip is two one-way prices.

**2. Membership status.** Miles can be redeemed only from a membership whose status is active on the membership record.

**3. Balance.** The mile balance must cover the full award price at the moment of redemption. Miles cannot go negative, and there is no miles-plus-credit combination.

**4. Fees on issue.** An award ticket booked fewer than the close-in window days of calendar days before its first departure carries the close-in award fee, and an award booked through the reservations call center carries the call center booking fee. Both fees are recorded on the redemption entry, and both follow the member's tier on the redemption date.

**5. Passengers.** An award ticket may be issued for any passenger the member names; the miles always come from the member's own membership.

**6. Cancellation with redeposit.** An award ticket can be cancelled with its miles redeposited only when the cancellation is made no later than the first scheduled departure of the award ticket minus the tier's cancellation cutoff hours. The cutoff is counted back in full elapsed hours from the award ticket's next scheduled departure, and a cancellation at exactly the cutoff is accepted; after it the miles are forfeited with the unused award.

**7. Redeposit.** A redeposit returns exactly the miles of the redemption entry and charges the redeposit fee of the tier held on the redeposit date; close-in and telephone fees are not refunded. Each redemption can be redeposited at most once.

**8. Earning and fare brand.** Award tickets earn no miles or qualifying dollars and are never booked on Crestline Basic Economy.

### Cutoff boundary (hypothetical, a 1-hour cutoff)

| First scheduled departure | Cancellation time | Miles redeposited |
|---|---|---|
| 14:00 | 12:30 | Yes |
| 14:00 | 13:00 exactly | Yes |
| 14:00 | 13:01 | No; the miles are forfeited with the unused award |

### Hypothetical pricing

A one-way award in the domestic zone in the Main cabin, with saver seats available on every flight, is priced from the saver chart; the same one-way award with no saver seat on one of its flights is priced from the standard chart. A round trip is priced as two such one-way prices.
